items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output 7.1 kW replacement)
items.rationale: Surge damage to a fixed unit nine metres from the hob, so the 2.3.10(c) five-metre exclusion does not apply and it is covered. Under 7.1.9, the larger unit is not new equipment. Under 7.1.10, indemnity is limited to an equivalent 3.5 kW like-for-like unit, priced at about the Case 38 level.
Labour for removing and fitting the replacement of an affected installation is covered under 7.1.9(c) as an ancillary charge following a covered principal item. Priced at the Case 38 level.
7.1.10's last paragraph applies: a console chosen for the room's appearance and not required to set the unit in place is not a replacement cost. It falls under 3.5(d) and 7.1.8(a) in its entirety.
Ordinary carriage of the covered replacement is indemnified under 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.12. The share attributable to the console may be apportioned out under 7.1.11. Priced near the Case 38 level.
7.1.12 excludes expedited or timed delivery surcharges unless the insurer agreed in advance or the surcharge was needed to mitigate loss; neither applies here.
Administrative and processing charges are not repair costs under 7.1.8(b). This line type was never indemnified in earlier cases.
